audit.whatIsWrong: report[14].t quotes '~54%'; the packet says 49.28% over 558 games.
audit.why: The page rounds a below-even matchup up into a comfortable win.
audit.corrected: report[14].t updated to 49.28%. I left the FAVOURED label alone — the level chart genuinely gives Yi five of seven rows — but the honest number now sits next to it.

audit.why: Malphite owns 1-2, even at 3, Yi from 4-5 onward. Chart matches the packet and both layers agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force is written as '~130/100s' with the middle rank guessed away, and no other cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: It is 130/115/100. Ground Slam is 7s and Seismic Shard 8s — the short ones are what actually govern a trade, and neither was on the page.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. First, the content layer calls Thunderclap '(E)' four times and describes it as armour — Thunderclap is W, the sonic-boom auto empowerment and an attack reset; the armour-scaling ability is Ground Slam (E). Second, and worse, Ground Slam's ATTACK SPEED REDUCTION appears nowhere on the page.
audit.why: Attack speed is the entire currency of Master Yi's damage. A 7s-cooldown ability that cuts it, scales off the armour Malphite was already buying, and hits at 400 range is the single most relevant thing in his kit to this matchup — and the page instead points you at the Q slow, which Highlander already ignores.
audit.corrected: whys[1], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1] re-lettered to (W)/(E) correctly; the attack-speed cut written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and content.mid. Thunderclap named as the auto-reset burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file puts a grounding flag on both Seismic Shard and Ground Slam. Riot's text for Q is damage plus move-speed steal, and for E is damage plus attack-speed reduction. Neither mentions grounding.
audit.why: If either genuinely grounds, Alpha Strike is denied and the whole plan changes — but the descriptions do not support it, and the brief says an empty or contradicted flag means unknown, never a fact to assert.
audit.corrected: I wrote no grounding claim in either direction. Listed in unverified for someone with a source to settle.

edits.before: Track his R (Unstoppable Force) above all — it's a ~130/100s point-and-click knock-up that catches you out of Alpha Strike; secondarily watch his W (armor + empowered auto) so you only trade when it's down.
edits.after: Track Unstoppable Force (R) above all — 130s at rank 1, a knock-up that catches you as Alpha Strike ends. Then watch Ground Slam (E) on 7s: its attack-speed cut is what actually blunts your DPS in a trade.

edits.before: E Wuju Style true damage ignores his stacked armor — the core of the matchup. Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge his R knock-up. Meditate's damage reduction + heal out-sustains his W-empowered auto. Highlander's slow immunity cancels his Q-slow kiting. His passive shield only soaks early chip, not your itemized on-hit DPS.
edits.after: Wuju Style's true damage ignores his stacked armour — the core of the matchup. Ground Slam (E) cuts your attack speed on a 7s cooldown and scales off the armour he was buying anyway, so it is the ability that hurts your DPS, not the Q slow. Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge his R knock-up, and Highlander cancels the slow.

edits.before: FAVOURED, ~54% — a scaling lane where you eat early Q poke but his armor-stacking tank identity is exactly what your true damage and on-hit kit ignore; respect only his R.
edits.after: FAVOURED, 49.28% — a scaling lane where you eat early Q poke, but his armour-stacking identity is exactly what your true damage and on-hit kit ignore; respect his R and his E.

edits.before: At 2 his Thunderclap (E) armor and shield still let him out-trade your early kit.
edits.after: At 2 his Thunderclap (W) auto and passive shield out-trade your early kit.

edits.before: Malphite pokes with Seismic Shard (Q) and shields with Thunderclap (E) armor plus his passive shield early, but he's mana-starved and slow; use Alpha Strike (Q) to dodge Q and Wuju Style (E) true damage to out-trade once his shield pops.
edits.after: Malphite pokes with Seismic Shard (Q) at 625 range and answers with the Thunderclap (W) auto reset behind a 10% max-HP shield; he is mana-starved and slow, so trade with Wuju Style (E) true damage once that shield has popped.

edits.before: Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) poke, Thunderclap (E) armor, and passive shield make the first two levels his — you can't out-trade a shielded, armor-stacking Malphite, so farm with Alpha Strike (Q), dodge his Q, and wait for his shield to expire.
edits.after: Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) poke, the Thunderclap (W) auto reset, and a 10% max-HP shield make the first two levels his — you can't out-trade that, so farm with Alpha Strike (Q), dodge his Q, and wait for the shield to pop.

edits.before: From level 3 it swings to you: he's mana-starved and slow, so Alpha Strike (Q) closes and dodges while Wuju Style (E) true damage cuts through his armor — just respect the level-6 Unstoppable Force (R) knock-up and bait it before you all-in.
edits.after: From level 3 it swings to you: he's mana-starved and slow, so Alpha Strike (Q) closes while Wuju Style (E) true damage cuts his armour — respect Ground Slam (E) cutting your attack speed, and bait Unstoppable Force (R) before you all-in.

edits.before: To poke with Seismic Shard (Q) and stack armor plus Thunderclap (E)
edits.after: To poke with Seismic Shard (Q) and stack armour for Ground Slam (E)

notes: The content layer had Malphite's W and E swapped in four places — Thunderclap labelled (E) and described as armour, when Ground Slam (E) is the armour-scaling one. More importantly, Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction was absent from the entire page despite attack speed being all of Master Yi's damage. Win rate was written as ~54% against a packet value of 49.28%. Both kit files flag Q and E as grounding while Riot's text mentions no such thing; I left that unasserted.
